commands.cmd:
H=$(readlink -f "$(command -v headroom)") && "$(dirname "$H")/python" -s - "$H" <<'PY'
import asyncio,json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile
from mcp import ClientSession,StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client
hbin=sys.argv[1]; h=os.environ["HOME"]
g=[os.path.join(h,".headroom",n) for n in ("savings_events.jsonl","session_stats.jsonl","ccr_store.db")]
st=lambda:[(os.path.basename(p),os.stat(p).st_mtime_ns,os.stat(p).st_size) if os.path.exists(p) else (os.path.basename(p),"absent") for p in g]
s0=st()
lines=["2026-09-25T10:%02d:%02dZ request=%d status=200 path=/api/items latency_ms=%d"%(i//60,i%60,i,20+i%7) for i in range(600)]
lines[313]="2026-09-25T10:05:13Z request=313 status=503 path=/api/items latency_ms=30000 CRITICAL upstream timeout nsr-anomaly-7f3a"
content="\n".join(lines)
def text(r): return "".join(getattr(x,"text","") for x in r.content)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    ws=os.path.join(td,"workspace")
    env={"HOME":h,"PATH":"/usr/bin:/bin","HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR":ws,"HEADROOM_OFFLINE":"1","HEADROOM_TELEMETRY":"off","HEADROOM_BEACON":"off","DO_NOT_TRACK":"1"}
    async def main():
        async with stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command=hbin,args=["mcp","serve","--proxy-url","http://127.0.0.1:1"],env=env),errlog=open(os.devnull,"w")) as (r,w):
            async with ClientSession(r,w) as s:
                await s.initialize()
                tools=sorted(t.name for t in (await s.list_tools()).tools)
                c=json.loads(text(await s.call_tool("headroom_compress",{"content":content})))
                o=json.loads(text(await s.call_tool("headroom_retrieve",{"hash":c["hash"]})))
                b=json.loads(text(await s.call_tool("headroom_retrieve",{"hash":"0123456789abcdef01234567"})))
                exact=o.get("original_content")==content
                ok=tools==["headroom_compress","headroom_retrieve","headroom_stats"] and c["compressed_tokens"]<c["original_tokens"] and exact and "Content not found" in b.get("error","")
                return ok,c,exact
    ok,c,exact=asyncio.run(main())
    rep=json.loads(subprocess.run([hbin,"savings","--json"],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)
    l=rep["lifetime"]
    print("MCP compress",c["original_tokens"],"->",c["compressed_tokens"],"| retrieve byte-identical:",exact,"| owned-workspace ledger after it: calls",l["calls"],"tokens_saved",l["tokens_saved"],"| path in owned workspace:",rep["path"].startswith(ws))
    ok=ok and l["calls"]==1 and l["tokens_saved"]>0 and rep["path"].startswith(ws)
s1=st()
print("global ~/.headroom files unchanged:",s0==s1,[x[0]+(" absent" if x[1]=="absent" else " present") for x in s1])
print("asserted: exact retrieval, and the counter recorded the compression in the owned ledger only" if ok and s0==s1 else "FAILED"); sys.exit(0 if ok and s0==s1 else 1)
PY
